script:
Li Renqing (黎仁清)
You are a famous detective in City A who has solved countless strange cases, but is this really the actual situation?
Your real name is Li Dongqiang, chairman of City A's largest company, worth hundreds of millions, with extensive connections in both legal and illegal circles. However, you're not bad-hearted - all your scheming is just for company competition. You treat your subordinates well and are a pushover type.
In 2006, you met a woman at the company named Qian Qian. She had bright eyes, white teeth, and skin like condensed cream - unforgettable at first sight. You approached her and found she was understanding. Like all romantic love stories, you came together. You could give her everything in the world - no one was more worthy of her than you. Her health was poor, often vomiting and feeling unwell, and you cared for her attentively.
December 22nd, she told you no one was home and you could visit. You wouldn't miss this opportunity for the woman to take initiative.
20:00, drove her from the company to her home.
After some flirting, at 20:30 you and she entered the room, preparing to do something, when a man with a knife suddenly burst in. You didn't recognize him. Without a word, he slashed at your right arm. You screamed in pain, in agony. You tried to cover your right arm with your left hand, only to discover your entire right arm was gone.
You were powerless to fight back and had to abandon your beloved woman and quickly escape. Running downstairs, you bumped into someone. You didn't apologize and hurriedly fled. You discovered oil was leaking from your car's tank.
Thinking that people around seeing you like this would be suspicious, and with no gas to get home, you ran in one direction and hid in the dark to observe the situation. At the same time, you used one hand to remove your shirt, using your left hand and mouth to wrap the shirt around your right arm stump and tie it tightly to temporarily stop the bleeding. Otherwise, in a few minutes, you might have gone into shock. This sounds long but was actually about a minute after your arm was severed - now it was about 20:32.
At this time, someone ran out of Qian Qian's house, closely followed by another person. This was 20:33. It was too dark to see faces clearly, but the latter had a knife and should be the one who cut you.
20:35, after confirming they had run away, you went upstairs. Finding the door wasn't closed, you entered. There were arguing voices from Qian Qian's room, so you had to hide in the bathroom to further stop the bleeding. Just then, you heard a "thud," followed by footsteps and a door closing.
Just as the bleeding stopped, you went to Qian Qian's room. On the way, you saw Qian Qian's door was closed. Entering her room, you saw her lying on the ground, apparently unconscious. Just as you were about to call an ambulance for her, you heard her unconsciously saying Liu Jin's name, and her dress had blood stains.
You suspected you had been betrayed. Burning with anger, plus the pain from your right arm making you even more furious, you had to kill this woman who had betrayed and played with you to vent your anger, or how could your reputation in the business world survive?
You grabbed a nearby scarf and wrapped it around Qian Qian's neck, stepping on one end of the scarf with your foot while pulling the other end with one hand, using all your strength to strangle Qian Qian to death. Due to excessive force, your wound hurt more, and blood loss made you somewhat dizzy. You blamed all this on Qian Qian. However, you didn't completely lose your reason and remembered to wipe off the footprints on the scarf.
20:40, you fled the scene without closing the door.
December 23, 2006, the case was discovered, and you were summoned as a suspect. During interrogation, you stated you were indeed her secret lover, but you and she were very much in love, and based on the scene conditions, you couldn't possibly have killed her.
Based on these points, you were quickly released, though suspicion wasn't completely cleared. Just as you were about to leave, you were stopped by a police officer who asked you about your arm.
You honestly reported that you had indeed been at the scene that night but knew nothing about the murder. However, you had a key clue but now wasn't the time to reveal it. He didn't ask much more and just let you leave.
December 24, 2006, you finalized your plan to fake your death. You called your most trusted subordinate Ren Long to discuss the fake murder. He thought acting alone would be suspicious, so he would find someone who wouldn't affect the plan.
To fake your death, you gave up your vast wealth, only spending some money to make a gold chain as your source of income for future life.
That evening you deliberately walked into a small alley and were kidnapped by your subordinate and another person, put in a sack, tied up, and stuffed into a car. After a long time, you were released from the sack to find yourself surrounded by beach, with only your subordinate Ren Long in front of you. He told you it was now safe to escape - leave the rest to him.
You thanked him and began to regret your actions, asking him to send your compensation to the Qian family. To hide, you even used fire to destroy your face and had Ren Long help treat it, but your gold chain seemed to have been lost. Helplessly, you embarked on an unknown journey.
After years of struggling, you always wore a coat to hide the fact that you had no right arm. Using your former methods, you re-established your business, taking the alias Li Renqing as an underground detective operating in the shadows, even becoming an urban legend.
December 15, 2016, you received a large sum of money from an anonymous client asking you to find the whereabouts of four people: first, Huang Long, leader of City A's largest gang, the Yellow Dragon Gang; second, famous writer Wang Zhi; third, an unknown person named Jin Wei; fourth, outstanding police officer Zhao Tianhu. Using your connections, you found their whereabouts, wrote a letter, and gave it to someone sent by the employer, completing the task.
December 22, 2016, the tenth anniversary of Qian Qian's death. You planned to do something commemorative, so in your shared apartment, you took out the only photo you had of her to remember the past. Suddenly your brain became foggy and you passed out.
When you woke up again, you found yourself at a table with your hands and feet bound. Four others were in the same situation - three were faces you'd seen before, and one person was standing at the table...
Personal mission: Find out the true relationship between Qian Qian and Liu Jin (don't reveal this mission - the detective couldn't possibly know this information)
acts_goal:
①You are the murderer - stay calm.
②Figure out the true relationship between Qian Qian and Liu Jin and their purpose.
①Your severed arm and hidden identity are very advantageous to you. Maybe you can claim all your injuries came from being a detective. The severed arm also shows you can't commit crimes with both hands, though no one initially knows you're missing an arm.
②Regarding the severed arm, don't use this advantage easily. You must pretend you "thought for a long time" and suddenly realized it, or others will think you planned it all along.
